name: Cape Town
tagline: Africa's best restaurant in a treehouse over the vineyards, and the gatsby that feeds four people.

La Colombe.description: Franco-Asian fusion in a treehouse over the Silvermist estate. Africa's best restaurant, among the world's top 50.

Mariam's Kitchen.description: Cape Town's most famous steak-and-masala gatsby, an urban classic since 1985.

FYN Restaurant.description: South African cuisine with Japanese technique from chef Peter Tempelhoff, a regular on The World's 50 Best Restaurants list.

Biesmiellah.description: Halal Cape Malay cuisine in the colorful heart of Bo-Kaap, run by the Osman family for more than four decades.

Kalky's.description: A fish-and-chips shack by the Kalk Bay fishing harbor, with the freshest fish on the peninsula.
